always: Photorealistic premium product render, ultra sharp, high dynamic range. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermark.

items.prompt: Perfectly top-down orthographic view of a flagship professional DJ media player jog wheel, exactly circular, centered, filling 96% of the square frame. From the outside in: a thick outer ring of black anodized aluminium with fine precise knurled grip ridges all around its edge; a thin bright cyan LED light ring; a wide satin brushed silver metal platter with fine concentric machining lines and one soft diagonal specular highlight; in the middle a large perfectly round flat glossy black glass disc (plain, empty, deep black, 56% of the full diameter) with a thin chrome bezel. Pure black background outside the wheel. Dramatic studio lighting.

Perfectly top-down orthographic view of a luxury club DJ turntable jog platter, exactly circular, centered, filling 96% of the square frame. Outer edge: gunmetal dark chrome ring with fine knurling; inside it a ring of tiny warm amber and magenta LEDs glowing; a dark smoked brushed titanium platter with very fine concentric grooves like a vinyl record catching rim light; at the center a large perfectly round flat glossy black glass disc (plain, empty, 56% of the full diameter) with a polished gold bezel. Pure black background outside the platter. Moody dramatic lighting.

Perfectly top-down orthographic view of one premium DJ mixer rotary knob, exactly circular, centered, filling 92% of the square frame: a black soft-touch knurled rubber skirt with fine vertical ridges around the edge, a machined brushed aluminium top cap with a fine concentric spun-metal finish, and one thin bright white indicator line running from the centre straight up to the top edge. Pure black background. Studio lighting with a crisp ring highlight.

Perfectly top-down orthographic view of one boutique DJ mixer knob, exactly circular, centered, filling 92% of the square frame: a glossy black ceramic body with a fine knurled edge, a concave dark gunmetal cap with concentric spun-metal rings, and a thin glowing white indicator notch running from the centre straight up to the top edge. Pure black background. Dramatic studio rim lighting.

Flat top-down seamless texture of a dark graphite brushed metal surface: very fine straight horizontal hairline brushing, subtle micro sparkle, deep charcoal almost black, perfectly even lighting with no vignette, no gradient, no objects, no edges. Tileable material swatch.

Wide cinematic background for a nightclub DJ booth: a dark club seen from behind the decks, deep navy and black, soft out-of-focus bokeh of magenta, cyan and warm gold lights, thin haze light beams falling from the ceiling, a faint glowing planet-like orb in the far haze. Very dark overall (mostly near-black) so controls drawn on top stand out. No people, no faces.

Wide cinematic background: a futuristic open-air DJ stage floating in space at night, a huge softly glowing golden planet Venus in the distant haze, stars, laser beams in cyan and magenta sweeping through light fog, extremely dark overall (mostly near-black) with lights only at the edges and the far distance so controls drawn on top stand out. Defocused, dreamy, no people, no faces.
